what: A fixed full-screen video frame inset 75px below the header and 30px on both sides with 10px rounded corners expands to fill the screen when the bottom edge of the first section touches the line 10% up from the bottom of the screen: margin · corners go to 0 over 1.4s power4.inOut, and the accompanying copy · news cards vanish in .5s. Scrolling back up returns it to a frame with the same curve — the frame video stays behind the page and shows through again as empty bands (windows) between the sections below

options.fade: Duration of fading out together (sec), default .5
options.fade-ease: Disappear curve, default same as ease
options.--fx-top · --fx-side · --fx-radius: Frame top margin · side margins · corner radius (css variables), default 75px · 30px · 10px — City phone is 6px
options.[data-fx-part=frame]: Fixed screen Frame (video·img inside). The bottom edge of the Section where the parts are attached is the threshold
options.[data-fx-part=fade]: (optional) things that disappear as it expands — the first copy and the floating news card

use: First phrase
note: The frame sits behind the page at z-index −1, so later sections are covered with a background color, and the video shows through only in the empty (window) section

from.where: index.js [data-kv-movie] — original .top-hero__movie (fixed, top 75px · sides 30px (20px at 1023 and below · 6px at 575 and below) · corners 10px), trigger .top-hero bottom bottom-=10%, toggleActions play none none reverse, copy and news .5s
